description: Write a payload larger than 1 MB into window.__pb_data[key], chunked past the CDP 1 MB message limit. Source: inline (`data`) or file (absolute `path`, read as binary). The page reads window.__pb_data[key] (string or ArrayBuffer per encoding) and window.__pb_data[key + '__complete'] === true. Never write one key from parallel calls — they race. Under ~200 KB use evaluate; for a real <input type=file> use file_upload.

chunkSize.description: Raw bytes per chunk before base64 (default 500000; max 700000)

encoding.description: utf8 (inline default) keeps a string; binary (file default) gives an ArrayBuffer for FileReader/Blob/fetch; base64 keeps the base64 string

key.description: Property name under window.__pb_data (JS identifier, see pattern)

source.description: inline: pass data. file: pass an absolute path, read as binary

name: set_page_data
